field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.issued_by: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].
field_descriptions.issued_through: The service through which the permit was granted.
field_descriptions.permit_audience: The target audience for this permit.
field_descriptions.valid_for: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.
field_descriptions.valid_from: The date when the item becomes valid.
field_descriptions.valid_in: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].
field_descriptions.valid_until: The date when the item is no longer valid.
